snippet.title: Poker Show VR Gameplay (Htc Vive, Oculus Rift, OSVR).
snippet.description:
Título: Poker Show VR Game.
Género: Casual, Indie
Desarrollador: Kogei 
Editor: Kogei 
Fecha de lanzamiento: 30 mayo 2017
Poker Show VR is an entertaining virtual reality poker game with a combination of classic five-card poker and real-world models as rivals, who take off their clothes elegantly when they lose.
